title: App: localized edits on high-res (4K/8K) images via crop-stitch
description:
MERGED INTO MPI-355 on 2026-08-01 - closed as rejected: not built, folded into the host card, kept here as the record. Original text follows.

New App. On a huge scene (4K/8K), the user masks a small region and edits just that - place a character, change an object - and the character stays sharp because the crop is sampled at working resolution instead of the whole frame being downscaled. Mechanism proven by the user on Qwen. This is the case where InpaintCropImproved/InpaintStitchImproved is RIGHT and ImageCompositeMasked is wrong (compositing needs a full-frame generation, unaffordable at 8K). Carries the known crop-stitch tone-patch trap and its root cause. Also tracks a dep-declaration defect found while scoping: app_head_swap.json uses the inpaint classes but nothing on the qwen-edit path declares the pack. Detail in brief.md.
